name: app-shater-three-phase-methodology-diagram-with-pill-tasks
title: Shater process methodology: three circled phase icons (Requirements, UX, Design) each with pill task tags
whatItIs: A light page with 'منهجية العمل والخطوات' (Work Methodology and Steps) and an intro, three columns each headed by a circled icon (document, clock, brush) labelled 'المتطلبات' (Requirements), 'فهم وبناء التجربة' (Understand & Build Experience) and 'التصميم' (Design), each with two or three pill task tags below, over screens of the finished product.
whatItMeans: Transparent and methodical; naming each phase's concrete tasks makes the process feel rigorous, not just decorative.
techniques: Represent each process phase with one icon and a name.
List concrete tasks as pill tags under each phase.
Preview the outcome faintly behind the process diagram.

vocabulary.definition: A distinct stage in a project's workflow.
A small rounded label for a short term.
